name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.81: adds a fridge planogram view to the dashboard machine-detail page for GR- machines. Shows baskets in their real physical shelves per cabinet (1-4, 5-8, 9-11, 12-14, 15-16) with product image, price (override vs inherited), unit weight and enabled state. A per-basket editor assigns a product via search picker (no id pasting), sets price (blank inherits catalog), measured unit weight, tolerance and enabled. A bulk-edit table sets all baskets at once. A recent-sessions panel shows settlements with mismatch flags. The coil price path and kiosk-designer action are hidden on fridges so the basket editor is the only price path. Product search now returns weightGrams for weight pre-fill. Cumulative over v5.80.
